reviews.title: Censorship
reviews.text:
I have updated the stars after Epoch reversed course and restored most of the deleted comments. I hope everyone stands against censorship. Don’t let your voice be silenced. I feel like 2 1/2 stars is the right number now. That’s obviously not an option. So 2 it is.

I have been an Epoch subscriber for about 4 or 5 years. In the last few years I started to notice some questionable coverage. Some misleading articles or articles that don’t tell the whole story. I also noticed some news that was just not covered. I would have to look at other outlets to find some stories. I started commenting on things that I found troubling. I also commented on things I found to be good. I originally subscribed to Epoch because I saw the extreme bias and irresponsible and sometimes downright dishonest coverage from virtually all media. I found the Epoch to be what other media once was. Something has changed in the last few years. I just read a movie review for The Odyssey. I thought writer made excuses for the clearly DEI motivated casting. I commented on what I believed to be true. I was respectful and I never used foul language. Most people on the page thought as I did. The writer responded to my posts. I found him to be a little snarky and sarcastic but I was in no way offended. After a few exchanges he did admit that my points were good. The last thing he posted was something like he enjoyed the debate. I agreed. reviews.title: I cancelled my subscription
reviews.text:
I canceled my subscription to The Epoch Times because of how frustrating it is to actually access the content. I receive 3–4 emails every day with interesting news or health articles. However, when I click on an article from the email, it takes me to their website but not to the article itself.

Instead, I’m prompted to sign in, and then I have to spend a lot of time searching for the article that was emailed to me. Even when I stay signed in, clicking links from their emails still doesn’t take me directly to the article—I often have to sign in again and search all over.

As an older person, I find this lack of ease and user-friendly design extremely frustrating and not worth the effort. Because of this ongoing inconvenience, I canceled my subscription and now read news from other, more accessible options.
